title: The charge dependent hard-sphere model: Polycrystals as low-energy configurations
summary: We investigate the emergence of rigid polycrystalline structures in atomistic ionic particle systems as low-energy configurations. The interaction between particles of opposite charge is modeled by hard spheres that interact when they are tangential. The interaction between particles of same charge is modeled as a hard repulsion that forces a minimal distance between them. The atomistic energy is frame invariant, and no underlying reference lattice is assumed on the ionic configurations.
